title: VQEL: Enabling Self-Play in Emergent Language Games via Agent-Internal Vector Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2503.04940v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Emergent Language (EL) focuses on the emergence of communication among artificial agents. Although symbolic communication channels more closely mirror the discrete nature of human language, learning such protocols remains fundamentally difficult due to the non-differentiability of symbol sampling. Existing approaches typically rely on high-variance gradient estimators such as REINFORCE or on continuous relaxations such as Gumbel-Softmax, both of which suffer from limitations in training stability and scalability. Motivated by cognitive theories that emphasize intrapersonal processes preceding communication, we explore self-play as a substrate for language emergence prior to mutual interaction. We introduce Vector Quantized Emergent Language (VQEL), a novel architecture that incorporates vector quantization into the message generation process. translated_title: VQEL：通过智能体内部向量量化实现涌现语言游戏中的自我博弈
translated_abstract: 涌现语言（Emergent Language, EL）专注于人工智能体之间通信的产生。尽管符号化通信信道更贴近人类语言的离散本质，但由于符号采样的不可微性，学习此类通信协议在根本上仍然十分困难。现有方法通常依赖于REINFORCE等高方差梯度估计器，或Gumbel-Softmax等连续松弛技术，但两者在训练稳定性和可扩展性方面均存在局限。受强调人际交流之前个体内在认知过程的认知理论启发，我们探索将自我博弈作为在智能体相互交互之前语言涌现的基础。我们提出了向量量化涌现语言（VQEL），这是一种将向量量化融入消息生成过程的新型架构。VQEL使智能体能够利用其内部导出的离散表示进行自我博弈，从而……
tldr: 提出VQEL架构，通过在智能体内部引入向量量化来生成离散符号表示，使智能体能够在交互前的自我博弈中涌现出符号语言，避免了传统梯度估计方法在符号采样不可微情况下的训练不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes VQEL, a novel architecture that incorporates vector quantization into the message generation process, enabling agents to develop discrete symbolic languages through self-play prior to interaction, thereby overcoming the training instability caused by the non-differentiability of symbol sampling in traditional approaches.
